scope: P4.1 source freeze; offline replays of the P3 DAB logs and an offline advice replay against the real advisors (P4 gate); no benchmark runs.

focused_pytest.command: python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q tests/unit/agents/test_injected_events.py tests/unit/app/routers/test_advisor_mode_router.py tests/unit/app/routers/test_loops_router.py tests/unit/config/test_advisor_mode_config.py tests/unit/modes/test_advisor_middleware.py tests/unit/modes/test_advisor_mode.py tests/unit/modes/test_advisor_privacy.py tests/unit/modes/test_advisor_trigger.py tests/unit/plugins/test_install_lock.py tests/unit/runtime/test_builder_mode_middlewares.py

broad_pytest.reason: Only privacy.py (used by advisor mode alone) and its tests changed since P4; see P4-validation.json for the repository-wide run and its pre-existing environment failures.

offline_replay.request_rebuild: Each of the 15 P3 consult requests rebuilt from acp-events.jsonl through the P4/P4.1 middleware; with privacy off the rebuilt request equals the recorded P3 request byte for byte except P4's FAILED labels on DAB errors.

result_id_tokens_left_unmasked.definition: Code-shaped tokens (5+ chars) in a privacy-on request that are a result id or a 5+ char prefix/suffix of one, excluding tokens in the task, plan or worker system prompt.

P4.1.note: all three are labels the worker wrote in its own code before any result showed them (variantA2_by_opp_owner, ...), so public by provenance

string_cell_values.definition: As in P4-validation.json (whole string cells of earlier results); it does not cover id pieces or keys, which is why it missed the P4 gaps.

placeholders_in_privacy_on_requests.note: changed only in the 4 affected consults

advice_replay_P4.design: Per consult and advisor (qwen3.8-max-0902, kimi-k3): privacy-off request twice, privacy-on request once, harness settings (temperature 0, max_tokens 32768, streaming); 90 calls. Blind pairwise judging by qwen3.8-max-0902 with the task, the unmasked question and the ground truth; 90 judgments.
notes: No privacy-on reply said data was hidden; all placeholders in replies restored.
Max PATENTS.query1 chose the wrong interpretation with privacy on when the deciding count (244 duplicate applications) was masked.
Run with the P4 gate; the P4.1 fix changes 4 of the 15 privacy-on requests.

conclusion: Both P4 gate gaps are fixed with regression tests; advisor tests, lint and offline replays pass. P4.1 has not been run on a benchmark.
